_about: The Archer's Stage 0 cards in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md), decided with Lucas on 2026-11-16 (book/cards/archer-redesign.md). THE BOOK reads these in the place of the cards of the same name in ../archer.json; Foundry reads these since pack F3 (v0.0.411; load.mjs loadFoundryCards, each card's `foundry` block); the ruler still reads ../archer.json until its own pass. The trait key 'projectile' is the renamed 'shot'. Format: see ../stage0/paladin.json.

cards.name: Shifting Aim
cards.flavor: You never loose twice from the same spot: a step to the side, and the line is clean again.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [Ranged, Strike] Actions gain 1 Field Boon if you have left your square this turn since your last [Strike] Action (or since your turn began).

foundry.automationNote: the Field Boon in the roll dialog when you have left your square this turn since your last [Strike] Action (or since your turn began): tracked from your token's moves. With it, the Archer's Starting Mastery: 5 with one Projectile weapon (the Mastery tab's choice; book, Mastery).

cards.name: Darting Blade
cards.flavor: You shift the bow to one hand, open a foe with the knife, and are gone before it turns.

body.label: Special
body.text: You make this Strike with a Light weapon you hold.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 2, then can stow the Light weapon you've drawn.

foundry.automationNote: draws a carried Light weapon with Setup, makes the Strike (only a Light weapon fits), applies Staggered (EoT) on Tier 3, runs Evade 2, and prompts to stow the drawn weapon afterward.

cards.name: Steady Draw
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3, `cards/basic-attacks-redesign.md`): the Archer's line on the shared Basic Attack (above the roll: it changes the damage).
cards.flavor: A rattled foe holds still for a heartbeat, and your second arrow follows the first.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [[Basic Attack]] gains, above its Attack line: **Strained:** Against a Strained target, a Tier 3 deals 1[D] more.

foundry.automationNote: on your Basic Attack's Tier 3 against a target already Strained when you roll, its damage rolls 1[D] more.

cards.name: Harrying Shot
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3, `cards/basic-attacks-redesign.md`): the Archer's Power Basic attack (no [Mod] in its damage, Lucas).
cards.flavor: You loose a shot meant to rattle, close enough that they flinch.

body.label: Bloodied
body.text: On a Tier 3, the target is Daunted of you (EoT).

foundry.automationNote: the damage; a Critical's 1d10! (a Basic attack); the Bloodied line's Daunted after the damage lands on a Bloodied target on a Tier 3.

cards.name: Quick Shots
cards.flavor: You loose arrow after arrow into one foe before the first has landed, and step away while it reels.

foundry.automationNote: 2[W] / 3[W] by Tier, the Evade 2 (the button), and +1 AP on a Critical (when applied).

cards.name: Strafe
cards.flavor: You run to a better angle and put an arrow into each of up to three foes.

foundry.automationNote: the Setup's Advance (the button), then up to three creatures, a roll each, Pushed 1 on a Tier 3.

cards.name: Slip Away
cards.flavor: The moment a foe commits to reaching you, you are already somewhere else.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy within 5 squares would enter a square adjacent to you (Move back: it stops before that square); Use: the Evade 1 and the Advance 2 (the buttons).

cards.name: Snap Shot
cards.flavor: A foe lunges for you, and you put an arrow in it before it has finished the step.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy would enter a square adjacent to you (Move back: it stops before that square); Use: the shot, Hindered (EoT) on a Tier 2, Immobilized (EoT) on a Tier 3.

cards.name: Footwork
cards.flavor: You are never where you were a breath ago: a long sidestep, a run through the press, or a step with your hands already busy.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. During this Advance, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you, and you can move through the squares of unwilling creatures (you can't end in one).

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 1, and before or after it you use the Interact or Reload Action (1A).

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Sidestep's Evade 3; Weave's Advance ignores Difficult Terrain and moves through unwilling creatures; Hands Busy's Evade 1 plus free Interact or Reload buttons.

cards.name: Trick Shots
cards.flavor: You put the arrow where it will do something other than wound: through a cloak, past an ear, square on a shield.

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick, the shot and each Mode's Tier 2 or 3 (Hindered, Vulnerable 1, the Pushes).

cards.name: Spotter
cards.flavor: You read the field the way others read a page: where a foe hides, where the gap in its cover is, where you yourself are hardest to hit.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your allies perceive the target one step better than they do: Hidden as Obscured, Obscured as Clear; Unsensed stays Unsensed (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your next [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn ignores the Banes of far and maximum range, and counts each target's Cover as one level lower (Total Cover stays Total).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Against each creature you have Cover from, your Cover is one level higher, up to High (1 round).

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Call Out (enemies perceive target one step better, 1 round); Find the Gap (ignores far/max range Banes and lowers Cover 1 level, Total stays Total); Keep Low (raises your Cover 1 level up to High, 1 round).

cards.name: Lean and Loose
cards.flavor: A wall is a quiver's best friend: you are out, the arrow is gone, and you are back.

foundry.automationNote: Lean costs 0 AP while your Escalation is 2 or more.

cards.name: Blade and Bow
cards.flavor: Arrow, knife, arrow: each sets up the next.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, when you use a [Melee, Strike] Action after a [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn, or a [Ranged, Strike] Action after a [Melee, Strike] Action this turn, it gains 1 Boon.

foundry.automationNote: the Boon in the roll dialog, once on each of your turns, on a [Melee, Strike] after a [Ranged, Strike] (or the reverse) this turn, while your Escalation is 2 or more.

cards.name: Thrill of the Kill
cards.flavor: One of yours drops, and your blood is up.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an enemy you have damaged goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

cards.name: Volley
cards.flavor: You send a flight of arrows high, and they come down on everything standing in one patch of ground.

foundry.automationNote: the Burst within your weapon's range, a roll per creature, 2[W] / 3[W] and Hindered by Tier, Prone on a Critical, then the Evade 2 (the button).

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.flavor: You run the length of the fight with the knife out, opening every foe you pass, and somewhere along the way an arrow leaves your bow.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. After each square of this Advance, you hit each enemy adjacent to you that this Action hasn't hit yet with a [[Light (property)|Light]] weapon. Once, at any point of the Advance, you hit one creature within your bow's Range with your bow. You draw and stow the two weapons freely during this Action.

body.label: Special
body.text: The bow's hit is Doomed if you are Engaged when you make it.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Weapon vs. Armor Defense. Roll once, when the first creature is hit: every hit of this Action uses that roll.

cards.target: Each enemy adjacent to you at any point of the Advance, and one creature within your bow's Range

foundry.automationNote: the Advance (the button) and one roll for the whole Action (Use it against the first creature; apply the same Tier to the others by hand); the free draws and the bow shot by hand.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.flavor: You keep the arrows coming down on one stretch of ground, and nobody crosses it without paying.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 2 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain and [[Hazardous Terrain]] for enemies [HT: Entering, Turn, Movement]: [V] damage equal to 2 + your Weapon Modifier, of your weapon's subtype.

foundry.automationNote: the Zone (2 rounds): Difficult Terrain and Hazardous Terrain for enemies (Entering, Turn, Movement): [V] 2 + your Weapon Modifier, Pierce (another subtype by hand).

cards.name: Clear Lines
cards.flavor: Your friends have learned where not to stand, and you have learned to shoot past their ears.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your allies give your targets no Cover, and your [Ranged] Actions take no Field Bane for a target Engaged with one of your allies.

foundry.automationNote: your allies give your targets no Cover, and no Field Bane for a target Engaged with an ally, while your Escalation is 4 or more.

cards.name: Opening Shot
cards.flavor: Your arrow staggers the foe, and your ally's blade is already coming.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once a round, when you get a Tier 3 with a [Ranged, Strike] Action against a creature, one ally who threatens it can spend 1R to make a Basic Attack (1A) against it.

foundry.automationNote: on a Tier 3 of a [Ranged, Strike] Action, a line on the card names the allies who threaten the target; the ally's Basic Attack (1R) by hand, once a round.

cards.name: One More Arrow
cards.flavor: By now your hands move faster than you can think: there is always one more arrow in the air.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, when a [Strike] Action of yours deals [W] on a Tier, it deals 1[W] more to each creature on that Tier.

foundry.automationNote: the first [Strike] that deals [W] on each of your turns deals 1[W] more (the damage roll), while your Escalation is 6.

cards.name: Fleet
cards.flavor: Nothing on this field is as fast as you are now.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Each Evade of yours moves you 1 more square, and your Evades can enter Difficult Terrain.

foundry.automationNote: each Evade button moves you 1 more square while your Escalation is 6; entering Difficult Terrain with an Evade by hand.
